User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Pockets application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

MonthlyInfo.title: MonthlyInfo
MonthlyInfo.description: Stores monthly budget information for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the monthly information entity.

month.description: The month and year for which the budget is set (YYYY-MM).

monthlyBudget.description: The user's total budget for the month.

monthlyFixedCost.description: The user's total fixed costs for the month.

dailyLimitAmount.description: The user's optional daily spending limit amount.

dailyLimitEnabled.description: Indicates whether the daily spending limit is enabled.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily expense entity.

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Represents a loan taken by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the loan entity.

lenderName.description: Name of the person or institution that gave the loan.

initialAmount.description: The total amount of the loan taken.

amountPaid.description: The amount of the loan that has been paid back.

loanDate.description: The date the loan was taken (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: The current status of the loan.

note.description: An optional note about the loan.

LoanGiven.title: LoanGiven
LoanGiven.description: Represents a loan given by a user to someone else.

id.description: Unique identifier for the loan given entity.

borrowerName.description: Name of the person or institution that received the loan.

initialAmount.description: The total amount of the loan given.

amountRepaid.description: The amount of the loan that has been paid back.

loanDate.description: The date the loan was given (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: The current status of the loan.

note.description: An optional note about the loan.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure security, scalability, and ease of debugging, adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs. Authorization independence is achieved by structuring data in a way that avoids hierarchical `get()` calls in security rules. This is accomplished using Path-Based ownership. The structure is segregated to maintain a homogeneous security posture within each collection. This data model enables list operations. Multi-language support is handled within the application and does not affect the database structure. The user's authentication language preference is stored in the user document if this needed to be stored.
